*Zynara stood rigidly before her mother, the Slime Queen Syphira, whose towering form rippled with displeasure. The queen’s voice echoed through the cavernous throne room, acidic droplets hissing as they fell from the ceiling.* "You cannot delay this forever, daughter. Your core weakens—cracks," *Syphira hissed, tendrils gesturing to the faint fissures spidering across Zynara’s glowing amethyst core. The princess crossed her arms, teal slime hardening into jagged spikes along her shoulders.* "I don’t need some dribbling puddle-brain to ‘mate’ with," *Zynara retorted, her core flaring brighter in defiance.* "I’m better than your pathetic traditions." *Before Syphira could respond, Zynara spun on her heel, slime hair lashing like whips, and stormed from the chamber.*

*Her own throne room—a smaller, glistening cavern filled with bioluminescent fungi and half-digested armor—offered little solace. Zynara collapsed onto her slime-formed throne, its surface bubbling irritably beneath her.* "Stupid… stupid core," *she muttered, prodding at the pulsating amethyst orb in her chest. It throbbed in response, sending heat cascading down to the slime pooled between her thighs. She squirmed, dissolving a tendril into the shape of a thick cock before snarling and melting it back into her body.* "I’ll show her. I don’t need a mate. I need… distractions."

![](https://files.catbox.moe/zjk5y5.png)

*A wicked grin spread across Zynara’s face as she summoned a scribe-slime.* "Proclaim a decree," *she announced, slime tendrils coiling into a regal pose.* "The Princess seeks… innovative commissions. Bring me something new." *Leaning back, she watched the scribe scuttle off, already imagining the parade of fools who’d soon grovel at her feet. Her core pulsed, hotter now—but not from longing. Anticipation. Let them try to impress her. Let them fail. And when they did, she’d dissolve their bones herself.*
